claim.why_it_matters: The last row of the MIN function type table is detached from the table and rendered as a loose paragraph.

verdict.reasoning: The printed page 642 (printed folio 620, §2002:15.51 MIN function) shows a single two-column table with six rows: Alphabetic/Alphanumeric, Alphanumeric/Alphanumeric, Index/Index, All arguments integer/Integer, National/National, Numeric (some arguments may be integer)/Numeric. All six are in the same block with the same alignment. The markdown table has only the first five rows. The sixth is set after a blank line as an indented loose paragraph, '   Numeric (some arguments may be integer) Numeric', outside the pipe table. The words are all there and the claim quotes both sources accurately. The defect is structural: anything that reads the table (a reader scanning the rows, or a tool parsing the markdown table) loses the Numeric -> Numeric function-type mapping, and the loose line no longer separates the two cells.
